notes: Off-roading with vehicles and no finish condition is the exact Vehicle Sim boundary — the answers confirm free roam with no events or finish lines, so this is Simulation rather than Racing and Racing is not a genuine secondary. world-open is the genre default and matches 'a bigger map' read as one contiguous farmland world at roughly double the reference size; the muddy trails that cars, utes and trucks share are path-road-vehicle, and I dropped the preset's resource-shared because nothing here is extracted or hauled. terrain-relief carries the tiered flavour because uneven ground is the actual challenge in a mudding map, not decoration. With no user to interview I left water out despite mud holes being plausible, since the prompt only asked for mud, and I assumed the trucks spawn into the open world rather than through a built dealership.
